annotations.title: Get a one-click link to add a tracking domain's record

description: Get a link that adds this tracking domain's CNAME record at your DNS provider in one click, when the provider supports it. Open `url` in a browser: the provider asks you to sign in, shows the record and adds it once you approve, then sends you back to the console at `returnTo` (a console path like `/acme/settings`; left out, the console's front page). Nothing changes until the person who runs the DNS approves. Coming back proves nothing, so call check_tracking_domain to verify the record. When `url` is null, `reason` says why: `not_set_up` (this server can't sign links, so the feature is off), `not_offered` (the DNS provider can't add our record in one click, or the name is a DNS zone of its own, where a CNAME can't go), `unanswered` (DNS or the provider didn't answer in time: retry before changing DNS) or `nothing_to_add` (the domain is already verified). With a link, `provider` names the DNS provider. The link is offered only at DNS providers that accepted our template. The link adds this one record and nothing else. At most 30 a minute per workspace.

returnTo.description: A console path, with its query if it has one, where the DNS provider sends the person back after they approve the record, like /acme/settings. Not a full address, and no # part. Left out, they land on the console's front page.
